milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the jungle wood tree structure and look at it. Target is the center of the jungle wood trunk at spawn-relative (4, 2, 4). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the tree, not just passing nearby.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle_boat results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player must place the crafting table, open the 3x3 grid, arrange 5 jungle planks in a U-shape, and collect the resulting jungle_boat. This is the most direct and reliable check — the crafted item is not in the starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the fenced pig enclosure and look at a pig. Target is the center of the pig pen at spawn-relative (-3, 0, 3). The pigs are contained within an oak fence enclosure from (-5,0,2) to (-1,0,5), so they stay near this location. max_distance=16 allows detection from exploration range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the pig pen.
